limitations: One world2 development seed, not a confirmatory or heldout efficacy study.
Fixed warm arm order confounds latency with run order/system variation; report descriptive wall time only.
Native1 differs from conditional methods in feedback, proposals and internal capture; primary comparison measures the complete intervention rather than NN alone.
NoGraph means original hidden/sampling/action statistics with3forwards/capture; it is not a CRV attribution graph.
The NN estimates next-action failure, not long-horizon task utility. This experiment does not train policy weights or ES.
The .5 threshold triggers a second proposal in conditional arms; it is not a hard feasible-set exclusion. First candidate remains selectable.
Prompt request for a different packet is not enforced as rejection; matching uses exact parsed JSON, not semantic equivalence or unchanged hidden state.
Old offline NoGraph metrics motivated a new exploratory diagnostic; they do not establish online benefit or internal-signal causality.
Task score is primary; reduced action error without score gain is not success on the primary endpoint.

planned_mechanism_contrasts.interpretation: same frozen NoGraph predictor, temperature, conditional threshold0.5 and selection rule; intervention is the explicit feedback package, including distinct-packet request and prioritization of a matching past failure
planned_mechanism_contrasts.name: feedback_package
planned_mechanism_contrasts.not_identified: does not isolate the matching-failure excerpt alone, or create a same-hidden-state counterfactual

planned_mechanism_contrasts.interpretation: same fixed-two proposal rule, explicit feedback, capture procedure and shadow risk computation; selector differs: lower frozen risk versus original hash
planned_mechanism_contrasts.name: equal_nominal_compute_ranking
planned_mechanism_contrasts.not_identified: actual later histories/prefix lengths/candidate pools/latencies may diverge; not graph causal effect or exact wall-clock matching

primary.endpoint: official final_score_normalized at B30 or official natural terminal
primary.estimator: one paired final-score difference; retain each raw score
primary.source: each accepted result.environment_summary SHA-bound summary.json; cross-check fitness.scoreNormalized/source_summary
primary.success_rule: Only a strictly positive observed score difference is a task-score improvement for this one development case. Equal score is no task-score improvement even if failures or latency improve.

analysis_checks: source and registration SHA/Git identity; all5 ordered job IDs
actual original G0 and frozen NoGraph tensor/calibration identity
same initial public prompt and common proposal0 seeds; audit proposal1 seed equality where both generated
own fresh8 qualification and no candidate full graph/assemble
all budgets and final wholePG/subtree/CUDA/dual-lease closure
retention_and_analysis.failed_unknown: preserve reason/cost and leave unknown score null; do not impute0, drop an arm, rerun or substitute a seed
retention_and_analysis.partial_report: label interim with explicit completed/pending/failed counts; never stop/alter execution based on a partial metric

secondary.cost: actual attempts, candidate_count, NoGraph capture/forward counts, supported fractions and explicit feedback applications
secondary.failures: official action failures and adapter/parser rejections separately, plus their sum/actual agent attempts; no forced B30 denominator after natural early terminal
secondary.latency: episode_intent to episode_returned timestamps in original group events, including postepisode audit/serialization; cold model/NN/bank/qualification setup reported separately from model_load_intent to first episode_intent, never charged solely to first Native1
secondary.mechanism: matching_prior_failures/augmentation availability; second packet diversity, selected packet changes, exact repeated failed actions, official positive score transitions, and shadow ranking changes; no invented outcome for an unexecuted candidate
secondary.official_task_success: summary.success, reported as a separate paired Boolean outcome

temporal_limit: No later remote runtime observation was performed by this reviewer. The prior snapshot proves zero online only at its observation time; a follower spawn is not proof of either subsequent scientific execution or its absence. No p335 outcomes were inspected for this plan.
